variants.mechanism: Replace three MC2 pure padding calls by one three-output producer
variants.effect: Remove private call helper subgraphs under complete output/API contract; same required pad payload, plus removal of known BOOL conversions.
variants.condition: All outputs ready at required readers; hidden/logits/mask ownership and generation/capture/error semantics preserved. No automatic critical-path gain.

variants.mechanism: Write padded hidden/logits in their respective upstream producers and generate aligned mask directly
variants.effect: Avoid intermediates rather than copy them through a second pad kernel.
variants.condition: Preserve full-row RMS/router FP32 numerical domain, BF16 rounding, shared live hidden readers and MC2 output ABI. Existing F20 mechanism; no unproved cross-layer CSE.

variants.mechanism: Teach MC2/routing readers to interpret virtual zero/false padded rows
variants.effect: May avoid materialized padding and padded row work.
variants.condition: Requires new consumer/dispatch/EP-count/workspace contract. Existing fused MC2 baseline and distributed ordering retained; cannot merely change 816 to 800.

variants.mechanism: Directly materialize only the SP-owned output rows of each pure pad
variants.effect: Cut the full global pad invocation and its private helpers; rank-specific row map, true/zero tails preserved.
variants.condition: Fresh functional outputs/capture ownership; input row readiness and downstream row correspondence. Entire native operator replacement, not independent MemSet deletion.

variants.mechanism: Combine SP row selection with HC4 initialization, IDs, mask and initial premix
variants.effect: Use existing v67 direct initializer value map; new owner evidence identifies which pad helper subgraphs are in scope.
variants.condition: No hidden numerical arithmetic added; supplied True prefix retained; no-query KV/global restore/collectives still live. IDs/mask/premix all reader and bank protocols remain.

variants.effect: Can create a new direct functional output but cannot replace current clone by input view under existing alias contract.
variants.condition: No such no-pad invocation is established by this 104-initialization padding population.

variants.mechanism: Delete an isolated MemSet because PadV3 follows
variants.condition: 1272 owners are bound; actual destination, byte length, overlap and workspace-vs-payload remain absent.

variants.mechanism: Add unknown MemSet bytes to mandatory full Pad output writes as independent traffic
variants.condition: Overlap between helper writes and required output/pad writes is unknown; logical copy model is not HBM traffic.

variants.condition: SP output row V=0 does not remove KV publication/head restoration/global collective participants.
